goal: 在不改写 generation 35 或 selection-intent-v1 的前提下，让完整 Exact 装备以 Catalog-independent 合同进入受治理的四段发布链。
userValue: 玩家导入完整且最终被当前规则与 SimC runtime 确认的精确装备时，即使其未列入公开换装目录，也能在后续链路中保存、重载、生成不可变快照并模拟。
nonGoals: 不在 Task 1 判定 Exact authority、整套合法性、effect support、Catalog membership、持久化或 SimC readiness。
不从 itemId、相似 bonus、Catalog 或默认值补充 declaredItemLevel、variant 或其他装备事实。
不将原始插件导出文本写入 artifact、日志、template、queue 或公开 payload。

releaseSlices.planHeading: Release Slice 1：Catalog-independent Exact 模拟主链
releaseSlices.scope: 任务 1-6 的 Catalog-independent Exact 导入、authority、条件持久化、owner-scoped worker 与 v2 resolve/snapshot 主链
releaseSlices.gate: v1 canonical bytes/key frozen; raw text never leaves parser; incomplete/illegal/effect-support gaps fail closed before formal SimC task

releaseSlices.scope: 任务 7 的去身份化、幂等、有界 observation queue
releaseSlices.gate: request-time Catalog write count is zero and queue loss cannot block ready Exact simulation

releaseSlices.planHeading: Release Slice 3：三来源 Catalog Admission 与发布硬门禁
releaseSlices.scope: 任务 8 的 mythic_plus、raid、crafted admission 和 immutable candidate/CAS 发布门禁
releaseSlices.gate: catalog_non_simulatable_count and silent_default_fill_count are zero; failed candidate preserves Catalog/Manifest LKG

releaseSlices.planHeading: Release Slice 4：微信体验、候选环境与用户验收
releaseSlices.scope: 任务 9-11 的 typed API client、活动 Taro 体验、候选部署、真实微信验收和 Harness closure
releaseSlices.gate: candidate branch/runtime/rollback evidence is recorded and real WeChat acceptance is explicit before completion

mustChange: server/gear_canonical_kernel.py primitive validators, canonical bytes and private sealed documents
owner maps for Kernel ownership and gear_contracts.py slot-set ownership
later Exact, Progression, Effect and Envelope consumers must migrate only in their own replacement-plan slices
mustNotChange: v1 canonical bytes and identities, legal Task 1 v2 fixtures, selection-intent-v1, ResolvedLoadout, SimulationSnapshot and generation 35
Catalog contents and pointers, Exact authority, persistence, worker, Resolver/API and UI behavior
Task 3 and later consumers, migrations, deployment and runtime changes
raw plugin text zero-persistence, zero-logging and zero-echo privacy boundary
evidenceRequired: Task 1 RED then GREEN parser/contract tests, frozen v1 bytes and key assertions, and legacy canonical SimC wrapper regression
candidate branch/commit identity, file parity, targeted backend/domain smoke, rollback path, and later real WeChat user acceptance

ownership.factOwner: server/simc_gear_import.py owns only sanitized plugin-to-Exact-v2 parsing; server/gear_contracts.py and packages/domain/src/gear-intent.ts own structural canonicalization.

engineeringHealth.reason: Task 1 is limited to pure parsing and structural contracts; the frozen v1 byte/key regression prevents identity drift, and later slices retain runtime/candidate/user-acceptance gates.

dataPrivacyBoundary.rawPluginText: ephemeral parser input only; it must not be persisted, logged, templated, queued, included in artifact evidence, or returned in output payloads.
dataPrivacyBoundary.identity: class/spec and sanitized item identifiers are contract inputs; player name, realm and raw profile metadata are not Exact v2 facts.

candidateDeployment.beforeMerge: Deploy the candidate only after later runtime/API slices exist; record branch/commit, runtime file parity, health/API/read-model smoke, async state, and rollback path.
candidateDeployment.rollback: Restore the previous candidate/runtime code without changing immutable v1 records, Manifest generation 35, Catalog pointer, or sealed snapshots.

acceptanceEvidence: Complete 15-core-slot plugin input with omitted ilevel produces exact-loadout-intent-v2 declaredItemLevel=null and no raw profile text.
Conflict, duplicate, unknown option/slot, misaligned gem array, oversized UTF-8 text, newline injection and missing id return path-specific blocked diagnostics.
v1 parser/output and frozen ResolvedLoadout/SimulationSnapshot identities remain byte/key stable.
closureCondition: 真实微信中完整 Exact 导入、保存和 SimC 主路径未由用户验收前，release 不得标记完成；HTTP 200、unit test、candidate or deployment smoke 均不能替代此验收。

decisionLog.decision: 按 Exact-first 将模拟资格与 Catalog membership 解耦；Task 1 仅冻结 v1 并引入无 Catalog 输入合同。
